parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A unique token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The request body parameters that specify pipeline information. For more information, see [logstash.yml](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/logstash/6.7/logstash-settings-file.html).

sub_parameters.name: batchDelay
sub_parameters.description: The pipeline batch delay. Unit: milliseconds. Default value: 50.

sub_parameters.name: batchSize
sub_parameters.description: The pipeline batch size. Default value: 125.

sub_parameters.name: config
sub_parameters.description: The specific configuration of the pipeline.

sub_parameters.name: queueCheckPointWrites
sub_parameters.description: The number of queue checkpoint writes. Default value: 1024.

sub_parameters.name: queueMaxBytes
sub_parameters.description: The total capacity of the queue in bytes. Unit: MB. Default value: 1024.

sub_parameters.name: queueType
sub_parameters.description:
The queue type. Valid values:
- MEMORY: A traditional memory-based queue.
- PERSISTED: A disk-based ACKed queue (persistent queue).

sub_parameters.name: workers
sub_parameters.description: The number of pipeline worker threads. Default value: the number of CPU cores of the instance.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to save and deploy the pipeline. Valid values:

- true: Save and deploy.
- false (default): Save only.
